title: Build the new Eastbank primary school on the river terrace
problem: Eastbank needs a primary school for 420 pupils within walking distance.

alternatives.name: Hilltop site on Carter Road
alternatives.rejectionReason: Twenty-five minutes' walk for most families; the terrace is safe from flooding.

rationale: The terrace sits above the 100-year flood level and within walking distance of 80% of families.

assumptions.statement: The 100-year flood on the east bank stays below 2.4 m
assumptions.subject: river:east_bank

title: Keep Riverton General's backup generators on the ground floor

alternatives.name: Move generators to the roof
alternatives.rejectionReason: Structural work for a risk the flood study said we do not have.

rationale: The ground floor is above the 100-year flood level, so relocating the generators was not justified.

assumptions.statement: The 100-year flood on the east bank stays below 2.4 m
assumptions.subject: river:east_bank

title: Route the Eastbank evacuation over the Mill Street bridge

alternatives.name: Northern ring road
alternatives.rejectionReason: Adds eleven minutes; the bridge deck stays clear of a 100-year flood.

rationale: The fastest route out of Eastbank, and the bridge deck is clear of the 100-year flood.

assumptions.statement: The 100-year flood on the east bank stays below 2.4 m
assumptions.subject: river:east_bank

title: Approve homes on the east bank without an individual flood review

alternatives.name: Flood review for every permit
alternatives.rejectionReason: Adds months to every application for a risk below the design level.

rationale: Every east-bank plot sits above the 100-year flood level.
